anna_prod: heads-up — kicking off a short sync on the model 'tool compatibility' probe shape. key question: do we return full tool schemas to clients or a compact capability surface? :thinking_face:

sam_design: +1 for compact. full schemas are noisy and leak surface area. prefer tooling hints + a small enum set for capabilities.

kevin_backend: infra constraints: discovery responses must be bounded. proposal (TL;DR): provide tools: [{id, type, streaming, max_input_tokens, client_hint}], features: [..], limits: {max_total_tokens, max_prompt_tokens}. keep per-response < 4KB.

liam_pm: from a product POV customers want deterministic startup probes. SDKs will call once at init. launch criteria idea: 3 pilot customers using SDK probe + zero serious parsing regressions across eval set.

sophia_research: streaming semantics are subtle. we should expose streaming: 'none' | 'partial' | 'full' and a chunk_delimiter description. clients need to know whether tool outputs may be interleaved with text tokens.

anna_prod: draft example discovery payload (pseudo):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-5b-green",
  "tools": [
    {"id": "web_search", "type": "http", "streaming": "partial", "max_input_tokens": 2048, "client_hint": "query-string"}
  ],
  "features": ["function_calling", "structured_output", "rerank"],
  "limits": {"max_total_tokens": 8192, "max_prompt_tokens": 6144}
}
```

kevin_backend: also need caching semantics. discovery should be cheap: add ETag + 5m default TTL. SDKs can revalidate. we'll enforce rate limits on probe endpoints.

sam_design: UX note: avoid explosion of boolean flags. expose capability enums and a short human_readable "capability_notes" per feature for SDK/console messaging.

liam_pm: security + privacy ask: do we ever include tool endpoint URLs or auth scopes in this response? that feels risky for hosted APIs.

security-bot: sec: do not include internal endpoint URLs or credentials. fine to include tool 'id' and public interface hints. redact anything that could be used to enumerate infra.

kevin_backend: action: I'll produce a minimal OpenAPI-like example and a size budget by EOD. will add ETag support to the endpoint and a cache-control header default. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/512

sophia_research: quick thought — include an opt-in 'detailed_tools' flag for enterprise/deployed-private customers to get richer schemas (with stricter ACLs). keeps hosted endpoints smaller.

anna_prod: owners/next steps: spec doc (owner @anna_prod), infra changes (owner @kevin_backend), SDK mapping (owner @sam_design). security to sign off on redaction rules. sync Wed next week to align on required v optional fields. :thumbsup:

liam_pm: can we also list launch blockers? my short list: 1) SDK probe implemented, 2) cache/ETag behavior validated under load, 3) security signoff on field redaction, 4) 3 pilot customers.

anna_prod: perfect. I'll open the spec PR and ping folks. closing this thread unless new blockers pop up.
